It's essential to note that these changes in values and priorities can be highly individualized and may vary from person to person. Some people may experience a more profound shift in their values, while others may not notice significant changes. You were on holiday with your husband and should have been enjoying yourself not worrying about me!’ Apparently this was very much the wrong thing to say as she got all upset. Honestly I don’t think I was being an arsehole, just that my mum needs to cut the apron strings a little. But I await my judgement!
